description: Golden parity for teamIntel.getDashboardKpis' avgTenureYears: computeAvgTenureYears(members, nowMs) in @tims/shared. Asserted IDENTICALLY by the REAL TS export (tests/team-intel/tenure-diversity-fixtures.test.ts, which builds `new Date(createdAtMs)`) and the C# Tims.Domain.TeamIntel.TeamIntelMetrics.ComputeAvgTenureYears (Tims.UnitTests, ms directly). Pins: 365-DAY years (≠ the 30-day months in balance/comparison); mean over all members; round(years*10)/10 is JS half-UP (0.05->0.1, 1.25->1.3 — banker's rounding would give 0.0/1.2 and turn this red); empty -> 0. Timestamps are epoch-ms.
